inputs.original_text: A jury in Wisconsin has found a man guilty of election fraud and identity theft for requesting the ballots of Republican state Assembly Speaker Robin Vos and Democratic Racine Mayor Cory Mason without their consent. A Racine County jury on Tuesday found Harry Wait guilty of two misdemeanor election fraud charges and one felony identity theft charge following a two-day trial. He was acquitted of a second count of identity theft. Wait leads a group that makes false election claims. He admitted in 2022 that he requested the ballots to try to prove that the state’s voter registration system is vulnerable to fraud.
inputs.modified_text: This is more elite damage control playing out in Wisconsin. They've just hit Harry Wait with two misdemeanor election fraud charges and one felony identity theft for requesting the ballots of Robin Vos and Cory Mason without permission. He's the one leading a group that challenges the official election story, and he already admitted back in 2022 he was only showing how simple it is to game the whole voter system. Now the authorities are rushing to label it fraud so they can shut him down and shield the real operators behind the scenes. It's obvious this is a coordinated move by the hidden elites and institutions to bury anyone exposing the loose setup they can't afford to have scrutinized, since that would reveal exactly who's really pulling the strings.
